source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Cover the mouth and nose, dispose of used tissues, and clean hands after respiratory secretions","B":"Cough openly when symptoms are mild because source-control measures are unnecessary in that setting","C":"Reuse contaminated tissues during the visit because repeated use reduces unnecessary waste","D":"Skip hand hygiene after coughing or sneezing whenever a disposable tissue was used correctly"}}
source_row.rationale: CDC includes respiratory hygiene/cough etiquette within Standard Precautions. Symptomatic people should contain respiratory secretions by covering the mouth and nose, use and dispose of tissues, and clean their hands after contact with respiratory secretions.
source_row.source_detail: Summary Recommendations IV.C.2.a and Appendix A Table 4: cover mouth/nose when coughing or sneezing, use/dispose tissues, and perform hand hygiene after contact with respiratory secretions.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Guideline for Isolation Precautions, Respiratory Hygiene/Cough Etiquette
source_row.stem: Which instruction is part of respiratory hygiene/cough etiquette in a healthcare setting?
